scope: All 64 districts of Bangladesh; one newly generated geometry-derived point per district.

coordinate_convention.nasa_request: Pass longitude and latitude to the NASA endpoint's named parameters; never infer order from CSV position.

sampling_method.description: For each polygon component, select a horizontal scanline in the vertex-free vertical interval nearest the component bbox midpoint; pair all ring intersections by odd-even parity; take the midpoint of the widest interior span; for multipolygons retain the component candidate with the widest span; round to six decimals and revalidate.
properties: Uses only the pinned district geometry; no previous sampling coordinates or test interior-point fixtures are read.
Produces a strict interior point rather than a possibly exterior centroid.

boundary_source.providers: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS), OCHA ROAP
boundary_source.underlying_source_title_year: 2015 (from linked dataset title; differs from represented year 2020)
boundary_source.license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY 3.0 IGO)
boundary_source.attribution: geoBoundaries gbOpen Bangladesh ADM2; Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS), OCHA ROAP; CC BY 3.0 IGO. Sampling points are project-generated modifications.

district_directory.use: Existing application district IDs plus English/Bangla display names; IDs are application-owned, not official geocodes.

limitations: Each point requests regional gridded weather context; it is not a district-wide spatial average, farm measurement, weather station or surveyed field location.
Nearby district points may resolve to the same NASA weather grid cell. No NASA grid-cell IDs are assigned or inferred here.

The simplified administrative geometry is suitable for reproducible district association, not legal/survey precision; its simplification tolerance and positional accuracy are not established in this repository.
The source metadata says represented year 2020 while the linked underlying dataset title says as of 2015; current legal alignment is not established.
A single point does not describe within-district climate variation. Later collection must retain point-level provenance and must not label it a district average.

ai_assistance.human_direction: Saim set nationwide scope, prohibited reuse of previous weather coordinates, selected one verified interior point per district and limited work to the sampling registry.
ai_assistance.assistant_role: Codex inspected repository assets, implemented the deterministic generator/checker, generated artifacts and ran validation.
ai_assistance.review_status: Local mechanical validation completed; independent human source/method review remains pending.
